title.en: An Act to Provide for the Creation of a Branch of the College of Liberal Arts of the University of the Philippines in the Municipality of VIgan, Ilocos Sur, for the Provinces of Northern Luzon.

text.en:
A branch of the College of Liberal Arts of the University of the Philippines is hereby created in
the municipality of Vigan, Ilocos Sur, for the provinces of northern Luzon.
The administration and operation of this college shall be in the hands of the Board of Regents of the
University of the Philippines, as established in the Organic Law of said University, and the operating expenses
of the same shall be paid out of the funds appropriated for said University.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 19, 1921.
